name: terminal-monitor
description: A compact, real-time monitor for VS Code integrated terminals and AI coding agents.

terminalMonitor.quietThresholdSeconds.description: Mark an active terminal command as quiet after this many seconds without output.

terminalMonitor.completionNotifications.description: Show a notification when a task lasting at least 30 seconds completes successfully.

terminalMonitor.failureNotifications.description: Show a notification when a task exits with a non-zero code.

terminalMonitor.codexCompletionNotificat.description: Notify when a Codex turn changes to completed.

terminalMonitor.codexFailureNotification.description: Notify when a Codex turn changes to failed.

terminalMonitor.codexApprovalNotificatio.description: Notify when a Codex task starts waiting for approval.

enumDescriptions: Show Codex sessions whose working directory matches an open workspace folder.
Show Codex sessions from all working directories.
terminalMonitor.codexScope.description: Choose which Codex sessions Terminal Monitor lists. With no open workspace, all sessions are shown.

terminalMonitor.outputLineLimit.description: Maximum number of recent output lines kept for each task.

terminalMonitor.historyLimit.description: Number of completed tasks retained in the recent list.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
